0.17.0-alpha.194.en: Recognize charger Finish after ten seconds of confirmed electrical quiet, yield to the next vehicle after confirmed OFF, and show a possible-full-charge warning without changing SoC. Keep witnessed handoff and all electrical and budget guards.

Beobachtete Uebergabe und alle elektrischen sowie Budgetpruefungen bleiben erforderlich.
